title: RBT Supervision Log
sub: The BCBA’s record of the ongoing supervision of a Registered Behavior Technician (RBT): the RBT’s service days and hours, each real-time supervision contact (who, how, how long, what was covered, the feedback given and the follow-up), and a short observation checklist when the RBT is seen working with a client. Each month is checked against the BACB’s rules as the form holds them (5% of service hours, two contacts, one individual, one observation with a client); a year view, the RBT’s goals, a credential and PDU tracker, a printable monthly record with signatures, and a CSV of the year.

record.label: Confidential personnel record
record.page: Confidential personnel record. Keep for at least 7 years (BACB).
